name: @docsworth/extension
description: The Docsworth browser extension (Chromium, Manifest V3): a side panel over `docsworth serve`, saving a page or a selection (the context menu and the panel) and a Gmail button. Built into packages/extension/dist and loaded unpacked; never published.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && vite build -c vite.capture.config.ts
